final_topology.title: Hybrid Cloud for Finance
final_topology.description: Set up a hybrid cloud environment with Azure Red Hat OpenShift and secure connection to on-premises datacenter.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes an Azure Red Hat OpenShift cluster in the cloud, connected to an on-premises datacenter via a secure link, with all traffic filtered through a central firewall.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n20) that is connected to various nodes and zones, indicating that an asset inventory is maintained.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n21) that is connected to various nodes and zones, indicating that data flows are documented.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for 'Sensitive Data Zone' (z5) and 'Non-Sensitive Data Zone' (z6), indicating that data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n2) and an 'On-Premises Firewall' (n3), both of which are connected to various nodes and zones, indicating that firewalls are implemented and managed.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n9) that is connected to the 'Central Firewall' (n2), indicating that trusted DNS servers are configured.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA/Identity Server' (n10) that is connected to the 'Central Firewall' (n2) and 'Azure VPN Gateway' (n5), indicating that MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Proxy' (n11) that is connected to the 'Central Firewall' (n2), indicating that DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n12) that is connected to the 'Central Firewall' (n2), indicating that network-based URL filters are enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones and nodes that are interconnected in a way that supports a secure network architecture, including segmentation and management zones.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Management System' (n22) and a 'Secure Protocol Management System' (n23) that are connected to various network components, indicating that network infrastructure is securely managed.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA/Identity Server' (n10) and a 'SIEM' (n18) that are connected to various nodes, indicating that network AAA is centralized.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure VPN Gateway' (n5) that is connected to the 'MFA/Identity Server' (n10), indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' (n17) in the 'Management Zone' (z3), indicating that dedicated computing resources are established and maintained for administrative work.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS Sensor' (n13) that is connected to the 'Central Firewall' (n2) and 'SIEM' (n18), indicating that a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zone links (zl1-zl7) that are peered, and the 'Central Firewall' (n2) is connected to these zones, indicating that traffic filtering is performed between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA/Identity Server' (n10) and an 'Azure VPN Gateway' (n5) that are connected to the 'Central Firewall' (n2), indicating that access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Network Traffic Flow Log Collector' (n24) that is connected to various network components, indicating that network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIPS Sensor' (n14) that is connected to the 'Central Firewall' (n2) and 'SIEM' (n18), indicating that a network intrusion prevention solution is deployed.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' (n15) that is connected to the 'Central Firewall' (n2), indicating that port-level access control is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' (n16) that is connected to the 'Central Firewall' (n2), indicating that application layer filtering is performed.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for 'Sensitive Data Zone' (z5) and 'Non-Sensitive Data Zone' (z6), indicating that production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Host' (n19) and a 'Penetration Testing Management System' (n25) that are connected to the 'External Testing Zone' (z7), indicating that periodic external penetration tests are performed.
